# `unique-items-added`

uniqueItems added

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` in requests, `info` in responses |
| **Rule IDs** | `unique-items-added` (both directions), `unique-items-added-in-request`, `unique-items-added-in-response` |
| **Status** | Planned (M5) |
| **Group** | Schemas ([RULES.md section 7](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

`uniqueItems: true` was added.

## Why this default

In requests: arrays with duplicates are rejected. In responses: clients receive arrays without duplicates, which is safe.

_No example yet: one is added with the rule's test case when the rule is implemented._

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file, for the generic ID or any variant ID above (the more specific ID wins). The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  unique-items-added: info
```

## How to fix

In requests, deduplicate on the server instead of rejecting.
